title: Glass in elevator hoistway enclosures.
officialText:
Glass in elevator hoistway enclosures and hoistway doors shall be laminated glass
conforming to ANSI Z97.1 or CPSC 16 CFR Part 1201 and ASME A17.1, as modified by Appendix K of this code.
